name: Navigation rail
statusNote: Expanded and modal presentations, and the collapsed<->expanded transition, are new; the plain collapsed rail's vertical item layout is unchanged from M3.
summary: A side-docked bar of 3-7 top-level destinations for tablet/desktop widths. Use collapsed as the default docked state; let it expand in place (or present modally) when the destination set needs labels or the surface plays the role a navigation drawer would on a phone.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: 3-7 destination items, each with selected, onClick, icon and optional label.

inputs.name: header
inputs.description: Optional top slot for a FAB or logo, above the items.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Whether the rail shows its expanded (wider, icon-start, labelled) presentation instead of collapsed.

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description: Whether the expanded state floats over content with a scrim instead of pushing the layout.

inputs.name: hideOnCollapse
inputs.description: Modal only: when true, the rail slides fully offscreen while collapsed (a dismissible drawer); when false, the collapsed rail always stays resident.

inputs.name: itemIconPosition
inputs.description: Per-item icon position. Defaults to tracking the rail's expanded state (top when collapsed, start when expanded) but can be pinned explicitly.

inputs.name: gesturesEnabled
inputs.description: Modal only: whether drag/anchor gestures can drive the collapsed<->expanded state.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Full-height column anchored to a screen edge.

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.description: Optional top slot for a FAB or logo, above the items.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.description: Icon + optional label, one per destination.

anatomy.name: Active indicator
anatomy.description: Pill behind the selected item's icon (and label, when expanded).

anatomy.name: Badge
anatomy.description: Optional small dot or numeral anchored to the icon.

anatomy.name: Scrim
anatomy.description: Modal, expanded only: dims the rest of the screen.

variants.description: Docked default; icon-top vertical items; 3-7 items.
Docked, wider, icon-start horizontal items; replaces a drawer; >=3 items.
Expanded state floats over content with a scrim instead of pushing the layout (modal-* tokens).

layout.text: Collapsed width is container-width; the plain (non-expandable) rail instead floors its width at the narrower narrow-container-width — narrow is the legacy/M3 value, the wider default is the Expressive one.
Expanded width is clamped between container-width-minimum and container-width-maximum; within that range it hugs the widest item or header content.
Item icon position follows rail state: top (stacked) when collapsed, start (icon beside label) when expanded, bound automatically; a caller can still pin either position explicitly.
Vertical gap between stacked items is item-vertical-space while collapsed, and collapses to none while expanded (items instead rely on each row's own height).

Per-item minimum height is the baseline item's container-height while collapsed; while expanded it drops to the accessibility minimum touch size instead, since the row grows to fit the horizontal icon+label content.
Top inset before the first item (or header) comes from the rail state's top-space token; the space reserved between a header and the item list is header-space-minimum.

Indicator geometry differs by item orientation: vertical items center a fixed width x height pill under the icon; horizontal items use a full-row-height pill inset by the baseline item's leading/trailing space and wrap the icon+label as one group.

Standalone (non-modal) collapsed/expanded containers are edge-to-edge rectangles (full-bleed, no corner rounding); the modal expanded container instead uses a rounded modal shape and its own elevation, since it floats above the app content rather than sharing its edge.

states.label: non-modal-transition
states.text: Rail width, item vertical spacing, and item min-height all animate together on a default-spatial spring; an item's icon-position interpolation (top to start) rides the same family.

states.label: modal-transition
states.text: The same width/shape animation instead uses a faster spring for a modal rail, and colour/scrim fades use a default-effects spring.

states.label: modal-default
states.text: Default modal behaviour (hideOnCollapse = false): the rail is always visible collapsed; expanding grows it in place over the content, showing the scrim once the width has animated past a settle point of 30% progress.

states.label: modal-hide-on-collapse
states.text: hideOnCollapse = true makes the rail a dismissible drawer: it slides fully offscreen when collapsed and the scrim tracks whether the target state is collapsed at all.
Single-select (role tab, selectable group), same as the navigation bar.

behaviour.text: Collapse/expand is driven by a two-state value (Collapsed/Expanded) rather than a boolean flag, so a renderer can also drive it as a draggable anchor point.

Collapsed vs expanded is a rail-level state; item icon position is a per-item property that merely defaults to tracking that state — keep the two independently overridable for animated or mixed layouts.

keyboard: Arrow keys move focus within the tab group.
Enter or Space selects the focused item.
semantics: Each item has role tab and a minimum touch target even where the visual row is shorter (collapsed state).
Modal-expanded state should be announced as a transient overlay (like a drawer): trap focus while the scrim is showing, restore focus to the trigger on dismiss.
Screen readers announce label and selection state per item regardless of icon position.

notes.text: Don't conflate the plain collapsed-only rail's narrow-container-width with the Expressive collapsed default container-width; they're different tokens for different rail capabilities (fixed rail vs expandable rail), not two sizes of the same component.
Modal expanded elevation/shape only apply while the rail is actually overlaying content; a non-modal expanded rail keeps the flat, unelevated, square-edged container.
